system.description: As part of inflicting the Mental Overwrite condition, you attempt to siphon the mental energy of an affected creature. They suffer a -2 penalty to their next saving throw before the beginning of your next turn and you can ask one question telepathically, as they must answer telepathically. The question must be in a format were answering Yes, No or I don’t Know are acceptable answers, and they must answer truthfully, using one of the 3 answer options available.
